title: From Power to Precision: Learning Fine-grained Dexterity for Multi-fingered Robotic Hands
summary: Learns fine-grained dexterous manipulation for multi-fingered hands by jointly optimizing control and hand design in simulation and on real robots.

title: GaRLILEO: Gravity-aligned Radar-Leg-Inertial Enhanced Odometry
summary: Proposes an odometry system that fuses radar, leg and inertial measurements using gravity alignment to obtain robust odometry in challenging environments.

title: Unidirectional-Road-Network-Based Global Path Planning for Cleaning Robots in Semi-Structured Environments
summary: Introduces a global planner based on a unidirectional road network to generate efficient, collision-free paths for cleaning robots in semi-structured environments.
